## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; pockets of strength in Healthcare and Technology while overall breadth is weak, and leadership concentrated across a few names. Confirmations: weak sector breadth (2/11) plus major 1W vs 1M divergences among large caps — suppress strong directional calls.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY; Technology showing selective strength: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND. Energy has strong individual names (MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND) but mixed internals.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication weakest: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -14.48%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Financials are also weak: CEG (1W: -10.55% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND; ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors), so be selective.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence risk: several large caps (MSFT, V, MA, JPM) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — tactical moves, not broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but with high-quality winners: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: +0.30% (24 stocks) — selective leadership amid thin breadth.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on the week: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -2.93% (20 stocks). Style: Value/cyclical not broadly leading — reduce exposure to weaker bank names while monitoring stress signals.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing relative strength at the sector level: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +1.98% (17 stocks). Watch earnings/FDA news as catalysts; LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY flags short-term rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Healthcare and high-quality Tech names showing ABOVE TREND performance (e.g., AMD, TMO, PANW) and selective Energy shorts of opportunity (MPC/VLO showing strength). Reduce exposure to weak Communication and stressed Financial names (NFLX, BAC, GS) and monitor major 1W/1M divergences before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +1.98% | 17 stocks) for catalyst-driven moves. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -5.35% | 10 stocks) and Financials (1W: -2.93% | 20 stocks) for follow-through weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch confirmation triggers rather than prices: NVDA needs sustained weekly gains to keep ABOVE TREND momentum; AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND holding a weekly pullback would confirm resilience; BAC/GS further weekly downside beyond -5% would signal deeper financial stress. Monitor sentiment flow into top names for conviction.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (+70): ISRG wins EU nod for da Vinci SP (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY — news confirmed by price strength. MPC (+60): Analyst upgrades/earnings beat (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND — price action confirms accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BAC (-85): Bond-loss headline (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — news aligns with sharp price weakness. NFLX (-50): Analyst downgrade (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. MSFT (-45): Litigation headline (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION — news is a potential risk while 1M still positive.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as weak breadth (2/11) and concentrated winners create uncertainty. AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND and TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major 1W vs 1M divergences across large caps and negative sentiment around banks (BAC -85) — monitor for trend breaks.
